title: Step 2 - Support Vector Regression: Building a Predictive Model in Python

cues.en: -: Okay, actually this is all we had to change in this regression template.
cues.zh: 其實，這就是迴歸模板需要修改的全部內容。

cues.en: And now we're ready to execute the sections one by one to create our model and find out about the final results, and the final verdict, whether it's truth or bluff.
cues.zh: 現在可以逐段執行，建立模型並查看最終結果，判定他說的是真話還是虛報。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: I'm going to import the data set first.
cues.zh: 我先匯入資料集。

cues.en: All right, here we go.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Well imported.
cues.zh: 已成功匯入。

cues.en: We can have a look.
cues.zh: 看一下。

cues.en: So these are data set with the levels as the independent variable and the salaries as the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 資料集以職等為自變數，薪資為應變數。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And, no need to split the data set into the training set and test set.
cues.zh: 不需要將資料分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: No need for feature scaling because we're using the very popular E 10 71 library that includes it.
cues.zh: 也不必做特徵縮放，因為常用的 e1071 套件已包含這個處理。

cues.en: And now, let's create our model.
cues.zh: 現在建立模型。

cues.en: So, I'm going to select this whole section here.
cues.zh: 選取這整段。

cues.en: Press command and control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control+Enter 執行。

cues.en: Done, regressor created.
cues.zh: 完成，迴歸器已建立。

cues.en: Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now let's predict the new result.
cues.zh: 現在預測新結果。

cues.en: Would you like to start by visualizing the SVR results first or predicting the new result?
cues.zh: 想先將 SVR 結果視覺化，還是先預測新結果？

cues.en: Well, let's actually predict the result because this is the most exciting step, and let's keep the best for the end.
cues.zh: 我們先預測，因為這一步很令人期待，把最好的留到最後。

cues.en: But this step is actually very exciting also, because we are getting the final prediction, we are getting the final predicted salary.
cues.zh: 其實這一步也很精彩，因為會得到最終預測，也就是預測薪資。

cues.en: So, you know, it's as you want.
cues.zh: 所以順序由你決定。

cues.en: If you're doing actually this code by yourself, before me, that's actually a very good exercise.
cues.zh: 如果你在我示範前自行完成程式碼，那是很好的練習。

cues.en: So I really encourage you to do this.
cues.zh: 我非常鼓勵你這樣做。

cues.en: Choose whatever you want to execute first.
cues.zh: 可以自行選擇先執行哪個部分。

cues.en: It's ready anyway.
cues.zh: 反正都已準備好了。

cues.en: You don't need to change anything more now.
cues.zh: 現在不需要再修改其他內容。

cues.en: So I'm going to execute that right now.
cues.zh: 我現在執行。

cues.en: And actually, we obtain a predicted salary of $177,000.
cues.zh: 得到的預測薪資是 177,000 美元。

cues.en: Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So remember this employee who we are negotiating the future salary right now said that its previous salary was 160 K
cues.zh: 記得，正在與我們洽談未來薪資的這位員工，說過去薪資是 160K，

cues.en: and our model predicted that its previous salary was 177 K.
cues.zh: 模型則預測其過去薪資為 177K。

cues.en: So first of all, that's actually close to what this employee said, and besides, it's on the good side of the negotiation.
cues.zh: 首先，這和他的說法很接近，而且對我們的談判也有利。

cues.en: So that's actually pretty good, and then we can be satisfied with this result and our model.
cues.zh: 所以結果很好，可以對模型和結果感到滿意。

cues.en: But to be really satisfied, let's see what's happening with the graphic results.
cues.zh: 不過，為了更確定，再看看圖形結果。

cues.en: So I'm going to execute this section, and let's have a look at the SVR model.
cues.zh: 執行這一段，查看 SVR 模型。

cues.en: And here it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: I'm going to zoom on it.
cues.zh: 我將圖放大。

cues.en: And, better.
cues.zh: 這樣比較清楚。

cues.en: Okay, so first of all, this model fits very well, most of the data points.
cues.zh: 首先，模型很貼近大多數資料點。

cues.en: As a reminder, the real observation points are the red points here.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，紅色點是真實觀測值。

cues.en: And all the points in this blue curve here which is the SVR model itself, are the prediction points.
cues.zh: 藍色曲線就是 SVR 模型，曲線上的點都是預測值。

cues.en: So for example, if we're taking this red observation point here, well, the prediction is perfect because the prediction point is the projection of this red point on the blue curve.
cues.zh: 例如這個紅點，預測非常準確，因為它投影到藍色曲線上的預測點，

cues.en: So it's actually the red point itself because the red point is on the blue curve.
cues.zh: 就是紅點本身；紅點位於藍色曲線上。

cues.en: So that makes a perfect prediction.
cues.zh: 所以這是完美的預測。

cues.en: But here, for example, if we take a less accurate prediction, but still a very good one then we take the real observation point here, the red point we project it on the blue curve, and that's the difference
cues.zh: 若看這裡稍微不準、但仍很好的預測，將紅色真實觀測點投影到藍色曲線，就能看到差距，

cues.en: between the real salary and the predicted salary, which is here, if we project it back on the Y axis, which contains the salaries.
cues.zh: 也就是真實薪資與預測薪資的差異，再投影到代表薪資的 y 軸即可讀取。

cues.en: But you can see that for all of these points from this one to, actually, this one the blue curve is actually getting very close to the real observation points, the red points.
cues.zh: 從這一點到這一點，藍色曲線都非常貼近紅色的真實觀測點。

cues.en: And so the predictions are very close to real results.
cues.zh: 因此預測和實際結果很接近。

cues.en: But that's for all these points of the data set except for this one here.
cues.zh: 除了這一點，資料集中的其他點都是如此。

cues.en: This one is left alone.
cues.zh: 這一點被單獨留在外面。

cues.en: Which, by the way, corresponds to the CEO.
cues.zh: 它對應的是執行長。

cues.en: So I'm sorry for the CEO, but the reason for what is happening here is that this is actually an outlier, not to call the CEO an outlier, but this is an outlier because as you can see
cues.zh: 很抱歉，執行長，但原因是這個點屬於離群值；不是說執行長本人，而是這個點

cues.en: this point is actually far from the other points in terms of salaries.
cues.zh: 的薪資和其他點相差很遠。

cues.en: The CEO has a much higher salary than the previous positions.
cues.zh: 執行長薪資遠高於其他職位。

cues.en: So for the SVR model, that's an outlier and therefore he actually didn't consider it.
cues.zh: 對 SVR 模型來說，這是離群值，因此沒有特別考慮它。

cues.en: It's like it excluded this point in the model by not looking at it and making its predictions on these points here.
cues.zh: 彷彿模型排除了這個點，只根據其他點做預測。

cues.en: So that's specifically due to the SVR algorithm itself but there are a lot of parameters and you can actually play with the parameters to change the way the SVR model perceives outliers.
cues.zh: 這是 SVR 演算法的特性；但有許多參數可調整，改變模型處理離群值的方式。

cues.en: So for example, these parameters are the penalty parameters, the regularization parameters.
cues.zh: 例如懲罰參數與正規化參數。

cues.en: It's most of the time well-described in the description.
cues.zh: 說明文件通常會詳細介紹。

cues.en: And of course, E 10 71 library includes such techniques.
cues.zh: e1071 套件當然也包含這些技術。

cues.en: But we're not gonna do it here in this tutorial because we actually don't need to get a good prediction of the CEO salary.
cues.zh: 不過這個教學不調整，因為我們不需要精確預測執行長薪資。

cues.en: And remember what we actually needed was a good prediction of the previous salary of this employee we're negotiating with, and this employee has a level 6.5.
cues.zh: 我們真正需要的是這位員工的過去薪資預測，而他的職等是 6.5。

cues.en: And around this point, we can see that the SVR model fits very well to our data set, and we actually get a prediction of 177 K, quite close to the real, or, the mentioned salary
cues.zh: 在這個位置附近，SVR 很貼近資料集，預測為 177K，接近實際或他所聲稱的

cues.en: of this employee, which is 160 K.
cues.zh: 160K 薪資。

cues.en: So that's actually pretty good.
cues.zh: 因此結果很好。

cues.en: And therefore the verdict of truth or bluff according to our SVR model, is rather truth.
cues.zh: 所以，依 SVR 模型判斷，他較可能說的是實話。
